scope: Proposition 4.7 (Saturated path and coherence) of the manuscript “Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions” (preprints/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 078 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ea18d159eefcdc7f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. statement: The sequence in Proposition 4.6 can carry, on one joint law of (T, c), saturated observations Gu at every positive dyadic time u ≤ 1. Their shapes satisfy b(1) = 0, a(1) = m, b(r) ≥ b(t), a(r) + r ≤ a(t) + t (r < t), e(u) := a(u) − b(u) ≥ mu. They can be constructed so that H(Re(u) | T, Cu) = o(1). There is a constant Kγ, independent of r, t, for which the orientations at r < t agree with probability tending to one at every positive depth d < min(e(r), e(t)) − Kγ |b(r) − b(t)| + |a(r) − a(t)| + t − r  . (4.8) All statements refer to the inner ϵ limit with the times fixed.
